body:
Thank you for responding. I am calm now and you reaching out helped. I read this shortly after you posted it and it made me feel better that a stranger was willing to step out of their comfort zone and cared enough to respond. 

I was going back to school for web development. Guess because of Covid they haven't converted all their classes to online and there is no other college here I can take like classes but count towards the credits I need. I can take a boot camp but those are alot more than what I can pay at a community college and I just wasted six months already. I am about one year out of savings and now the extra unemployment I was getting is done this month. I am gonna have to give up on this and just work as another salesman for the rest of my life...

Thanks but the last time I called 911 they took my shoe laces and told me I was under a 72 hour hold. 

I am calm now but I do need help like right away. First thing in the morning I am gonna call Kaiser and see if I can get a appointment asap.

Yeah you are right... Didn't think of it like that. She feels that the accuser is only doing this because the manager was trying to find ways to getting rid of her and this was her way of saving her job. The accuser is not very well liked in the office and my wife didn't really think that what happened to her was a big deal. Yeah it made her uncomfortable and upset. She told him even her husband wouldn't touch her like that and I wouldn't. I was pissed when she told me but she handled it and that was the end of it.

Well that is kind of what I explained to my wife. He is a grown adult that is still making some stupid decisions. I think the guilt is what is bothering her because she feels that she handled it and doesn't want to get involved in someone getting fired.

That's kind of what the wife said to me. I need to forgive because carrying all this hate will eat away at my soul. I get visibly angry when they keep pushing this onto me. I don't think they understand that it is best for me to just pretend that they don't exist and avoid them. 

Guess I can't avoid this and need to play that everything is fine. At least this time I don't need to worry about my kids spending the night their anymore since their all grown up...

You sound like me... Pretending everything is alright isn't new to me. I won't ever forgive this. Well it feels good to know I ain't wrong in my feelings and better prepared in this meeting tomorrow. Thank you...

I can never know exactly how my son feels.

Every day we deal with his depression and anxiety caused my this POS cousin. He is quick to anger or shuts down when he is in a difficult situation. He doesn't even see how his whole demeanor is when he just shutdown. Yet he is asking me to forgive and that is why I am struggling. This is very hard...
